We need to determine appropriate charges based on facts.

Facts: In 2015 high school exam registration, defendants (邓某 and 付武1) accepted bribes to illegally register 135 students not qualified for Jiangxi province. They also forged official documents (school and police seal) to create false academic and household certificates. So crimes: accepting bribes (受贿) maybe also "利用影响力受贿"? But they are officials? They are presumably staff of education department? The text says "违反江西省高考招生政策、违规为他人办理高考报名". They accepted bribes. So charge: 受贿 (bribery). Also "招收学生徇私舞弊罪" which is a specific crime: "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件"? Actually there is a label "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件". But the list includes "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件". However the description says "招收学生徇私舞弊罪". Not in list. The list includes "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件". That's a different crime (failure to hand over criminal case). Not applicable.

Also forging state documents: "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". Indeed they forged school and police seals, which are state documents. So charge: 伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章.

Also bribery: "受贿". Possibly also "行贿"? No, they received bribes, not gave.

Thus final answer should include two charges: 受贿;伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章
